decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that gained a dedicated page by 2024 and sits very close to the firm’s design-led core range, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping open in a growing market.

This product stayed prominently marketed in both 2023 and 2024, and because it extends the firm’s established drainage and architecture offering, the evidence supports further exploitation rather than abandonment.

Because this 2023 pump-assisted solution disappeared from the website by 2024, the option value appears to have resolved negatively and resources are better reallocated to stronger or newer drainage concepts.

As a 2024 launch with a dedicated page and clear fit with the firm’s existing drainage know-how, it is still an early-stage option whose uncertainty has not yet fully resolved, so keeping it on the market is justified.
